name: Grakmaw
description: A giant multi-headed hydra haunting the Ondu Skyclave, possibly created by kor experiments, killed when Anowon petrifies it.

timeline.summary: The emissary offers Tarsa's party a job in Ondu, killing the hydra Grakmaw in the Jwar Isle Skyclave, for a per-head payment.
Grakmaw attacks, but Anowon's idea of becoming cold lets the party hide beneath snow from its heat sense.
timeline.quote: You all need to become colder!

timeline.summary: Tarsa objects to Anowon taking kor poisons, and Grakmaw attacks the proving room.
timeline.quote: Any hands that know how to twist Zendikar are the wrong hands.

timeline.summary: Anowon throws a kor potion, shattered by Nadino's blade, that turns Grakmaw's heads to stone and kills it.
timeline.quote: In a matter of seconds, all the beast's heads were sharp, spiked stone

relations.note: His potion petrifies and kills the hydra.
relations.quote: In a matter of seconds, all the beast's heads were sharp, spiked stone

relations.note: The hydra dragged Orien to the proving room and tore him up.
relations.quote: That damned . . . thing . . . dragged him here . . . tore him up . . .
